description: Looks up a canonical Monad token by symbol (e.g. 'USDC'), name ('Tether'), or returns an 0x address unchanged. Falls back to DexScreener search for non-canonical tokens.

network.description: Monad network — "mainnet" or "testnet". Defaults to the server's configured network.

name: resolve_token
title: Resolve a token symbol/name to its Monad address
